policy: Only open-licensed films (Creative Commons), U.S. Government public-domain works, and full films uploaded free by the rights holder (or its licensed showcase) on official channels. No trailers, no unofficial copies. Action shelves: full films posted free by their rights holder or licensed distributor (e.g. Shout! Studios, iQIYI) or by the filmmakers themselves on their own channels.

items.title: Singularity
items.synopsis: A painterly space adventure: when a black hole swallows a small critter's icy home, he finds refuge among luminous creatures and a mysterious celestial being. Blender Studio's first 4K HDR film.

items.title: Can Trees Save the Planet?
items.synopsis: Planting trees is sold as a silver bullet for climate change and species loss. DW asks how well it really works, and whether mass planting can make things worse.

items.title: Backbreaking Work: Deep-Sea Fishing in the Arctic Ocean
items.synopsis: Six weeks at sea on a Cuxhaven trawler hunting cod out of Tromsø: round-the-clock shifts, pay by the catch, and a breakdown far from shore.

items.title: Laughing to Survive: On Tour with the Palestine Comedy Club
items.synopsis: Six Palestinian comedians form a stand-up troupe and take it on tour. A comedy show that turns into a plea for humanity in the face of terror and war.

items.title: Mission in the Alps: The Mountain Rescuers
items.synopsis: When fog rolls over the Blaueis glacier in the Bavarian Alps, the Ramsau mountain rescue team goes out after a stranded climber.

items.title: Cosmic Dawn: The Untold Story of the James Webb Space Telescope
items.synopsis: Behind the scenes of Webb's delicate assembly, testing and launch from French Guiana, told by the people who dreamed it up. NASA+ original.

items.title: Planetary Defenders
items.synopsis: What would we do if an asteroid were heading for Earth? The astronomers who track near-Earth objects and work on planetary defense. NASA+ original.

items.title: Artemis I: The Documentary
items.synopsis: Following the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft on the path to the pad and around the Moon on Artemis I.

items.title: The Spider Within: A Spider-Verse Story
items.synopsis: Even Spider-Man goes through things: Miles Morales in a short about mental health, released free by Sony with the Kevin Love Fund.

items.title: By Train Through the Caribbean
items.synopsis: Riding St. Kitts' narrow-gauge sugar-cane railway, built 1912-1926 and now one of the last working lines in the Caribbean, along 30 km of coast.

items.title: Wing It!
items.synopsis: An uptight engineer gets an unwelcome visit from an enthusiastic wannabe pilot, and both end up launched skyward in an out-of-control space shuttle.

items.title: Once Upon a Studio
items.synopsis: 543 characters from a century of Walt Disney Animation sneak out of their frames for one big 100th-anniversary group photo.
items.source: Walt Disney Animation Studios (official YouTube, verified)

items.title: Charge
items.synopsis: In an energy-starved dystopia, an old man breaks into a battery factory and finds himself cornered by a deadly security droid.

items.title: The Flying Sailor
items.synopsis: Two ships collide in a harbour and a sailor is blown skyward, contemplating the wonder and fragility of existence. Oscar-nominated NFB short by Amanda Forbis and Wendy Tilby.
items.studio: National Film Board of Canada / Wendy Tilby & Amanda Forbis
items.source: The New Yorker Screening Room (official YouTube, licensed showcase)

items.title: Kerim's Climate Odyssey
items.synopsis: A Norwegian climatologist sails a ship-turned-research lab through the Caribbean Sea with the One Ocean Expedition, meeting coastal communities on the front line. Al Jazeera Witness.

items.title: Sprite Fright
items.synopsis: Rowdy teenagers on a woodland trip meet a colony of adorable mushroom sprites who turn out to be far less adorable than they look. 80s-style horror comedy (some cartoon gore).
items.source: Internet Archive mirror (CC BY 4.0 allows re-hosting)
items.note: Played from the Internet Archive copy because Blender Studio's YouTube upload is age-gated and will not play in embeds.

items.title: Down to Earth: The Astronaut's Perspective
items.synopsis: NASA astronauts on the life-changing experience of seeing Earth from the International Space Station.

items.title: Coffee Run
items.synopsis: Fuelled by caffeine, a young woman races through the rollercoaster memories of a broken heart.

items.title: Out
items.synopsis: A young man about to move in with his boyfriend hasn't told his parents yet, until a magical body swap with his dog changes everything. Pixar SparkShort.

items.title: Curaçao and Climate Change
items.synopsis: Fourteen-year-old Julieta rescues sea turtles on Curaçao, where warming seas and pollution are changing the island's coast.

items.title: Countdown to Mars: A Story of Perseverance
items.synopsis: Behind the scenes of the Perseverance rover's July 2020 launch, and the team that kept going through a pandemic to get it there.

items.title: Hair Love
items.synopsis: A dad tries to do his daughter's hair for the first time on a very important day. Oscar winner for Best Animated Short (2020 ceremony).
items.studio: Sony Pictures Animation / Matthew A. Cherry
items.note: Released Aug/Dec 2019; won the Oscar in Feb 2020 (edge of the 2020+ window).

items.title: Spring
items.synopsis: A shepherd girl and her dog face ancient spirits to keep the cycle of life going. Blender Studio open movie.

items.title: Iron Shoulder
items.synopsis: After spotting a new drug route, anti-drug police in Tongchuan send an officer undercover to bring down the ring run by the ruthless 'Long Qi'.
items.note: Chinese online-premiere movie, posted free in full by iQIYI on 28 Sep 2026. Chinese audio with subtitles (turn on CC for English).

items.title: Quick Counterattack
items.synopsis: A security contractor back from years abroad storms a seaside town's online-fraud gang, alone, to find his missing daughter, while police close in on the same crime ring.
items.note: Chinese online-premiere movie, posted free in full by iQIYI on 16 Sep 2026. Chinese audio with subtitles (turn on CC for English).

items.title: Reckoning Day
items.synopsis: After witnessing wartime atrocities, a student abroad becomes a resistance fighter and takes on an occupying business cartel plotting to loot national treasures.
items.note: Chinese online-premiere movie, posted free in full by iQIYI on 4 Aug 2026. Chinese audio with subtitles (turn on CC for English).

items.title: New Dragon Gate Inn
items.synopsis: Ming dynasty wuxia: a swordsman protecting a framed minister's daughter and the empire's coastal-defence plan makes his stand at the desert inn of Dragon Gate.
items.note: Chinese online-premiere movie, posted free in full by iQIYI on 21 Jul 2026. Chinese audio with subtitles (turn on CC for English).

items.title: Blade Dancer
items.synopsis: A retired Interpol expert follows his vanished fiancée to Southeast Asia and walks into a sniper's war waged by an international terror group.
items.note: Chinese online-premiere movie, posted free in full by iQIYI on 10 Mar 2026. Chinese audio with subtitles (turn on CC for English).

items.title: 72 Hour Golden Operation
items.synopsis: Hong Kong-style cops-versus-gang action in Cantonese: police get 72 hours to smash the 'Disciples' gang terrorising their city. With Michael Tse and Lam Suet.
items.note: Chinese online-premiere movie, posted free in full by iQIYI on 7 Feb 2026. Chinese audio with subtitles (turn on CC for English).

items.title: Special Raid: Awaken
items.synopsis: A retired special-forces soldier travelling abroad with his family is dragged into a cartel deal, and goes alone into enemy territory when they are taken.
items.note: Chinese online-premiere movie, posted free in full by iQIYI on 26 Jan 2026. Chinese audio with subtitles (turn on CC for English).

items.title: Wild Journey
items.synopsis: A young fighter trying to make a living in the big city takes on a whole gang of relic thieves to save his friend and recover a stolen jade statue.
items.note: Chinese online-premiere movie, posted free in full by iQIYI on 21 Jan 2026. Chinese audio with subtitles (turn on CC for English).

items.title: No Trouble
items.synopsis: When racist punks threaten a Chinese restaurant, a cook on parole has to decide whether to fight back. Action drama short (BeyondFest, FilmQuest, Dances With Films).
items.note: Festival run before the filmmaker posted it free in full on 15 May 2026.

items.title: Special Delivery
items.synopsis: A food-delivery driver braced for a bad rating ends up in a full-on fight. Action-comedy short written and directed by Matt Thavornkaew, fights by Isaiah Kang.
items.note: Posted free in full by the filmmaker on 3 Apr 2026.

items.title: Night Shift
items.synopsis: A Saigon scooter-cab driver's past catches up with him over one long night of fights. Award-winning martial-arts short (Best Action Film, London Night Film Festival 2025).
items.source: Lorenz Hideyoshi Ruwwe's own YouTube channel (@HideyoshiR)
items.note: Festival premiere 2025; posted free in full by the filmmaker on 21 May 2026.

items.title: Battle Creek Brawl
items.synopsis: Jackie Chan's first Hollywood lead: in 1930s Chicago a young kung fu fighter is strong-armed by the mob into a bare-knuckle street-fighting contest in Texas. Directed by Robert Clouse (Enter the Dragon).
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)

items.title: An Eye for an Eye
items.synopsis: Chuck Norris is a San Francisco narcotics cop who quits the force to take down the drug ring that killed his partner. With Christopher Lee, Richard Roundtree and Mako.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)

items.title: Warlords of the 21st Century
items.synopsis: After the oil wars, a warlord's armoured battletruck terrorises the last free settlements, until a lone rider on a souped-up motorbike takes it on. Also known as Battletruck.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)

items.title: Winners and Sinners
items.synopsis: Fresh out of prison, five friends try to go straight and blunder into a Triad counterfeiting war. Sammo Hung directs and stars, with Jackie Chan as a roller-skating cop.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)

items.title: The Protector
items.synopsis: Jackie Chan plays a tough New York cop sent to Hong Kong with partner Danny Aiello to rescue a kidnapped heiress from a heroin kingpin.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)

items.title: Wheels of Fire
items.synopsis: Road warrior Trace tears across the wasteland in his armoured car to rescue his sister from a marauding gang. Cirio H. Santiago's Mad Max-style drive-in classic.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)

items.title: Legacy of Rage
items.synopsis: Brandon Lee's first starring role: framed for a cop's murder by his drug-dealer best friend, a young man comes out of prison looking for payback. Hong Kong gun-and-fist action.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)

items.title: Peking Opera Blues
items.synopsis: Beijing, 1913: a general's daughter turned revolutionary, a singer chasing jewels and an opera-troupe hopeful team up for stolen documents, rooftop chases and stunts. Tsui Hark directs Brigitte Lin, Sally Yeh and Cherie Chung.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)
items.note: Part of the Golden Princess library, licensed worldwide (outside parts of Asia) to Shout! Studios in 2025.

items.title: The Messenger
items.synopsis: Fred Williamson directs and stars as an ex-Green Beret, just out of prison, who wages a one-man war on the drug syndicate behind his wife's murder, from Chicago to Italy.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)

items.title: Equalizer 2000
items.synopsis: In a scorched future where the Ownership hoards the last oil, a soldier builds a monster multi-barrelled gun and turns it on his masters. Richard Norton, with an early Robert Patrick.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)

items.title: Gunmen
items.synopsis: Shanghai, 1920s: ex-soldiers join the police and go to war on an opium lord. Kirk Wong's gritty shoot-'em-up, produced by Tsui Hark, with Tony Leung Ka-fai, Adam Cheng and Waise Lee.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)
items.note: Part of the Golden Princess library, licensed worldwide (outside parts of Asia) to Shout! Studios in 2025.

items.title: I Love Maria
items.synopsis: A small-time crook and a hapless reporter take on a gang whose killer robot 'Maria' is tearing up Hong Kong. Cult sci-fi action comedy (aka RoboForce) with Sally Yeh, Tsui Hark and Tony Leung Chiu-wai.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)
items.note: Part of the Golden Princess library, licensed worldwide (outside parts of Asia) to Shout! Studios in 2025.

items.title: The Big Heat
items.synopsis: A Hong Kong detective whose gun hand is failing him takes one last case: his partner's murder by a ruthless syndicate. Brutal cop thriller produced by Tsui Hark, directed by Johnnie To and Andrew Kam.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)
items.note: Part of the Golden Princess library, licensed worldwide (outside parts of Asia) to Shout! Studios in 2025.

items.title: Bloodfist
items.synopsis: Kickboxing champion Don 'The Dragon' Wilson goes to Manila to find his brother's killer and fights his way through an underground tournament. Roger Corman production.
items.source: Shout! Studios (official YouTube, verified; owner of Shout! Factory)
